name: Shin'onsen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shin'onsen town emblem in blue and green: three curved strokes in blue and green, like a letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Shin'onsen, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Shin'onsen town emblem — three curved strokes in blue and green, like a letter C
